note: derived from a C against C A/A run; never widened after a candidate has been measured

rules.busy_host: check perf-gate-ready once; if busy do not wait, timing verdicts under 10% are INCONCLUSIVE, memory, allocation and count gates still run
rules.gate_policy: per case only; no aggregate decides a gate
invalid_run: direct ceiling under 1.25x the tunnel result (checked on unimpaired links; netem steps skip the direct run because the impairment, not the tool, limits the path and twice reorders what the direct path cannot)
granted socket buffers or offloads differ between arms
perf-gate-ready -1 reports overlap (applies only when the run started with a ready host)
rules.memory_and_count_effect: mean of per-pair difference in the metric's unit; tolerance max(one page, A/A spread) capped at 2% of the baseline value for memory, A/A spread for counts
rules.orientation: higher is better; lower-is-better metrics use the inverted ratio or negated difference
rules.timing_effect: mean of per-pair ln(candidate/baseline), 10000-resample seeded bootstrap, 95% interval

verdicts.INCONCLUSIVE: otherwise, or the A/A band exceeds the cap, or the host is busy and the effect is under 10%
